tagline.en: Google's Robotics Transformer — a language-conditioned robot policy that maps instructions and views to actions.
tagline.zh: Google 的 Robotics Transformer——一个语言条件的机器人策略,把指令与画面映射为动作。

en: RT-1 (Robotics Transformer) is a foundational language-conditioned robot policy from Google Research. It reads camera images together with a natural-language instruction and produces robot actions, and it was one of the models that popularized the transformer-based approach to real-robot manipulation.

In WorldFoundry the RT-1 TensorFlow SavedModel runtime is vendored in-tree. You point it at a locally staged RT-1 SavedModel directory, give it an instruction and observations, and it emits an action trace; benchmark wrappers handle environment replay and success metrics.
zh: RT-1(Robotics Transformer)是 Google Research 推出的、具有基础意义的语言条件机器人策略。它读取相机图像与一条自然语言指令,输出机器人动作,也是最早把 Transformer 方法带向真实机器人操作的模型之一。
在 WorldFoundry 中,RT-1 的 TensorFlow SavedModel 运行时已内置。你把它指向本地准备好的 RT-1 SavedModel 目录,给它指令与观测,它就会输出一段动作轨迹;基准封装负责环境回放与成功率指标。

whenToUse.en: When you want to run or benchmark a classic language-conditioned robot policy and can stage the RT-1 SavedModel locally.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想运行或评测一个经典的语言条件机器人策略,并能在本地准备好 RT-1 SavedModel 时。

notFor.en: Not runnable without a locally staged RT-1 SavedModel directory. It runs on TensorFlow rather than PyTorch, which may affect how it fits your stack.
notFor.zh: 没有本地准备好的 RT-1 SavedModel 目录就无法运行。它基于 TensorFlow 而非 PyTorch,可能影响它与你技术栈的契合度。

TensorFlow SavedModel runtime, emits action-trace outputs
